d: Short, wavy mint-green hair with white streaks and swept bangs, paired with sleepy, narrow mint-green eyes and a youthful, mature facial expression. A black bow sits between two long, upright white and pink rabbit ears, while a pink heart-shaped gem adorns the collar and leg straps. BODY COLOR: pale skin
